record.field:
Transcribe audio using a specified transcription model. This tool mirrors odoo_generate but targets speech-to-text workflows.
Parameters: model_id: The ID of the llm.model to use for transcription (must have model_use='transcription') inputs: A dictionary containing parameters according to the model's input_schema (for example {"attachment_ids": [1, 2], "language": "fr"})
Returns: A dictionary containing: - success: Boolean indicating if the transcription was successful - output_data: Provider and model metadata - results: List of result objects, one per attachment, including transcript text or an error - markdown: Ready-to-use markdown summary of the transcription output - content_count: Number of processed attachments
